name: Gotchi Galaxy
subtitle: Pixel-art pocket pets
description: A pixel-art pocket pet you raise, breed and take to far-away planets.

apps.name: Gotchi Galaxy
apps.subtitle: A pocket pet for your phone
apps.localizedDescription: A pixel-art pocket pet you raise, breed and take to far-away planets.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Mac: updates now arrive as a small download and apply in a second
- Settings shows the game and app version
- Fixes the Mac app not starting after the last update
- The Mac app now opens straight away, with no security warning

- New game: Cloud Hop, tap to fly through the clouds, alone or in a duel
- Five new thinking games: Fuel Line, Pet Cafe, Constellations, Pattern Train, Market Day
- Friends online: see who is on, send quick messages, get a ping on your phone
- Add a friend by code: your request waits in their Mailbox
- New mail shows as a letter in your room, one tap to open
- Deep Mine: about four floors a day, and floors you left stay as they were
- Back from placing furniture returns you to where you were

- New game: Yum Merge, slide the foods together, no top score
- Duel a friend or Chirpy at Yum Merge on the square
- Every square table now plays every game, Follow the Leader too
- Every game round pays 30 coins, win or lose, up to 450 a day
- Chirpy sits in at once when you are alone on the square
- Look in on a trip: tap your pet to chat with it
- Pet thoughts float over their heads, no bubble box
- Square play: everyone needs this version

- Meet Kumi, a rare nine-tailed fox: breed two carriers from Umbra to find one
- Kumi comes in jade or crimson, with a shell of its own
- Five new home sets in Shop > Home, each with a hanging light
- Look in on a trip: your pet reacts to its planet
- The pet profile shows its stage and birthday
- Camera pictures leave the menus out
- Festival games count while your pets sleep
- Moon Rabbit Ears rest while we redraw them
- Island play: everyone needs this version

- Plaza Expedition: dig the Deep Mine with a friend or Chirpy at the mine cart table
- Your team pickaxe upgrades itself from the ore you find
- Light a bomb to blast rocks open, in your own mine too
- Tap a rock to walk over and dig
- New gem-style ore icons
- Tidier screens: titles, numbers and icons line up
- The Night Sky Cloak shows its stars

- The Deep Mine: dig down 99 floors for six kinds of ore
- Craft a Crystal Cave room and gem wear from your ore
- Crack geodes at the Museum to fill the Gem Shelf
- Pick a ceiling light for each room
- Pets sit on more seats, and capes look right from behind
- Pinch to zoom in the room, the garden and the Plaza
- The Shop is on the room's bottom row
- Your pet's age shows its life stage
